args.goal: Test Lemon Squeezy as a route to sell the existing original SQLite invoice aggregation exercise. Read the full mission index and relevant checkout lessons first, and reuse any equivalent verdict. Read committed country and product policy captures if available. Use at most two additional first-party sources for the decisive seller activation, fees or payout terms. Verify the exact private-lab-v2 archive against its clean-extraction receipt and verify the source and redistribution authority for each offered file. Keep the companion quickstart out of the paid package if its rights are unresolved. If the exact product, Canadian payout and seller requirements support a trial, prepare one private listing packet tied to the archive hash, with the demonstrated learning benefit, provisional price, documented fee calculation, payout conditions and explicit activation prerequisites. Otherwise preserve the precise unresolved condition and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed packet or bounded verdict before closing with a valid lease and a lesson. Keep preparation, activation, sale, payout and verified Treasury settlement distinct. No signup, spending, external submission or public listing. Any eventual public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.
